evidence.detail: result_json assigned inside try inside for _ in range(3) loop; if all 3 FetchException attempts fail, result_json is never set, then result_json.keys() on line 236 raises UnboundLocalError
No commit found that fixes this variable-before-assignment pattern — bug is still present in current master

triage.fix_sketch: In magic/fetcher.py: before the `for _ in range(3)` loop (around line 231), add `result_json = None`. After the loop, add `if result_json is None: return False, [], []` (with an optional print/log noting Scryfall was unreachable). This handles total downtime gracefully instead of raising UnboundLocalError.
triage.notes: Affects only the /scry command and any other caller of fetcher.search_scryfall when Scryfall is completely unreachable for 3 consecutive requests.
